description: Semantic tokenization beyond BPE: FrameNet, SRL, WordNet, AMR, Universal Dependencies. Group tokens by meaning instead of morphology.

sub_projects.name: FrameNet

components.FrameNetLexicon: two-way frame ↔ word index, default Attack/Commerce_buy/Motion/Statement/Communication frames
components.FrameDetector: vote-based frame selection from token list
components.FrameNetService: BaseService + ISemanticAnnotator with idempotency and event emission

sub_projects.test_coverage: 8 tests: Attack/Commerce_buy detection, role assignment, unknown words, empty input, idempotency, save-before-dispatch, missing frame error

sub_projects.name: SRL

components.PredicateFinder: verb dictionary + suffix heuristics for predicate identification

sub_projects.test_coverage: 4 tests: predicate location, agent/theme/manner roles, no-verb sentence, empty input

sub_projects.name: WordNet

components.SynsetDatabase: synset id ↔ word reverse index, default mammal hierarchy + attack/purchase synsets
components.WordNetAnnotator: first-sense synset id attached to each token

sub_projects.test_coverage: 5 tests: synset lookup, hypernym chain, Wu-Palmer ordering (dog/wolf > dog/cat), unknown-word failure, annotator output

sub_projects.name: AMR

components.AmrPenmanParser: recursive-descent parser for nested (var / concept :role value) Penman syntax
components.AmrPenmanSerializer: graph → Penman string with cycle protection
components.SimpleAmrBuilder: first verb becomes root, ARG0 = pre-verb noun, ARG1 = post-verb noun

sub_projects.test_coverage: 5 tests: nested parsing, empty input failure, round-trip parse↔serialize, builder root selection, annotator output

sub_projects.name: UniversalDependencies

components.ConlluParser: tab-separated CoNLL-U parser, recovers # text = comment

sub_projects.test_coverage: 4 tests: CoNLL-U parsing, rule-based nsubj/obj/root, navigator children/head, annotator output
